answer_1.quote: We translated the Stanford Natural Language Inference Corpus (SNLI; ...) and the Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference Corpus (MultiNLI; ...) to create labeled NLI datasets for Turkish, NLI-TR.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the models on the test set of SNLI-TR and the matched and mismatched dev splits of MultiNLI-TR.

answer_4.quote: we assembled a team of ten Turkish-English bilingual speakers who were familiar with the NLI task and were either MSc. candidates or graduates in a relevant field.
answer_4.guideline: Each expert evaluated the translation by (i) grading the translation quality between 1 and 5 (inclusive; 5 the best) and (ii) checking if the translation altered the semantic relation.
